# Stage parameters

<!-- Generated by tools/Update-ParameterReference.ps1 from ai-code-review/stage-template.yml. Do not edit by hand: change the comments in the template and run the script. CI fails if this file is out of date. -->

Parameters of [`ai-code-review/stage-template.yml`](../ai-code-review/stage-template.yml), the PullPicket review stage. Pass them under `parameters:` where your pipeline uses the template. Model settings (`modelName`, `modelDeploymentUrl`, `reasoningEffort`) come from the variable group named in `modelVariableGroup`, not from parameters; see the [quick start](../README.md#4-create-the-variable-group).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `promptFile` | string | (required) | Path to the repository's rules file (or, with promptMode: legacy, its complete prompt), relative to the repository root. The file is left out of its own review. |
| `promptMode` | string | `rules` | 'rules' (default): promptFile is the repo's short rules file and the engine adds its shared base prompt (prompts/base.codereviewprompt.md). 'legacy': promptFile is the repo's complete prompt. Allowed values: `rules`, `legacy`. |
| `azureSubscription` | string | (required) | Azure Resource Manager service connection the review runs as. Its identity must be able to comment on pull requests (member of the Azure DevOps organisation) and, with foundryAuth: entra, hold the Cognitive Services OpenAI User role on the model's Azure OpenAI / Foundry resource. |
| `modelVariableGroup` | string | `ai-code-review` | Variable group with modelName, modelDeploymentUrl, reasoningEffort (and foundry-key for foundryAuth: key). |
| `metricsVariableGroup` | string | (empty) | Optional variable group for the metrics API. Leave empty to send no metrics. It holds aiMetricsApiUrl, plus aiMetricsApiResource (metricsAuth: entra) or aiMetricsApiKey (metricsAuth: key). |
| `metricsAuth` | string | `entra` | How the review proves itself to the metrics API (its AUTH_MODE). 'entra' (default) gets a token for aiMetricsApiResource, the API's application ID URI, with the service connection's identity, which needs the API's Events.Write app role. 'key' sends aiMetricsApiKey as X-Api-Key; the key is only mapped into the step in that mode. Allowed values: `entra`, `key`. |
| `continueOnError` | boolean | `false` | Set to true to let the pipeline carry on when the review step fails (for example, the model is unreachable). The step then shows as succeeded with issues instead of failed. |
| `aiReviewDebugLogging` | string | (empty) | Set to 'true' to log the full diff for one pipeline. Leave empty to use the aiReviewDebugLogging variable from the model variable group (false when unset). |
| `reviewPathSpec` | string | (empty) | Space-separated git pathspecs; only matching files are reviewed. Empty reviews every changed file. |
| `reviewExcludePathSpec` | string | (empty) | Space-separated wildcard patterns matched against repo-relative paths (such as 'docs/* *.generated.cs'). Matching files are skipped, on top of the default excludes. |
| `reviewMaxFilesPerBatch` | number | `25` | Most files sent to the model in one request. Larger pull requests are split into batches. |
| `reviewMaxBatchTokens` | number | `300000` | Approximate token budget for one request, prompt included. A batch the model rejects as too large is split in two and retried. |
| `reviewMaxFileTokens` | number | `80000` | Approximate token limit for one file's diff. Lines past it are not reviewed and the run summary counts the file as truncated. |
| `reviewDeletedFiles` | boolean | `false` | Set to true to list deleted file paths (not their content) in the review input, so the model can flag a risky deletion with a comment on the pull request as a whole. |
| `reviewDefaultExcludes` | boolean | `true` | Skip lockfiles, minified files and source maps, images, fonts, documents, archives and binaries. |
| `reviewRepoContext` | boolean | `false` | Experimental. Set to true to send read-only context from the rest of the repository with each batch: a map of the repository's files, plus excerpts of files that use what the pull request changes and of files the changed files import. It is read from the pipeline's own checkout with git (no extra access) and costs extra prompt tokens, up to reviewContextMaxTokens per batch. The model still only comments on the diff. |
| `reviewContextMaxTokens` | number | `12000` | Approximate token budget for repository context in one request. It is taken out of reviewMaxBatchTokens, so requests do not grow; the diff keeps at least half. Only used with reviewRepoContext: true. |
| `foundryAuth` | string | `entra` | 'entra' (default) signs in with the service connection's identity (it needs the Cognitive Services OpenAI User role on the Foundry account). 'key' uses the foundry-key variable from the model variable group instead; the key is only mapped into the step in that mode. Allowed values: `entra`, `key`. |
| `foundryTokenResource` | string | `https://ai.azure.com` | Resource the Entra token is requested for with foundryAuth: entra. The default suits Azure AI Foundry; use https://cognitiveservices.azure.com for a classic Azure OpenAI resource. |
